versions.changelog:
- Initial release of "Sacred Form — Indian Devotional Sculpture" skill.
- Defines style tokens and anti-tokens for the tradition spanning Gupta–Chola periods (4th–13th century).
- Outlines clear application rules for gestures, proportions, posture, multiplicity, and devotional surface finish.
- Provides evaluation criteria to assess narrative clarity, adherence to canonical proportion, and devotional qualities.
- References 15 historic Indian devotional sculptures from the Metropolitan Museum of Art as source material.
